Package com.hiface.sdk.search

Class InfraredSearchInfo

java.lang.Object
com.hiface.sdk.search.InfraredSearchInfo
public final class InfraredSearchInfo extends java.lang.Object
IR input and liveness decision attached to the same RGB search sample; never reused across frames.

Read the IR score from this object. FaceSearchResult.getLivenessScore() continues to represent RGB passive liveness only. Acceptance also requires the final MATCH_FOUND outcome and a qualifying RGB identity match.

    • getDetectedCount

      public int getDetectedCount()
      Number of faces detected in IR. It can be 0 when the RGB multiple-face check ends the flow before IR detection runs.

    • getFaceBounds

      @Nullable public FaceSearchFace.Bounds getFaceBounds()
      Present when the SDK returns a usable IR face box. A detected but unselected face may have no box. Coordinates are in IR image pixels.

    • getRealScore

      @Nullable public java.lang.Float getRealScore()
      Null means no valid model result was produced. Zero is a valid rejection score and must not be treated as missing.

    • isPassed

      public boolean isPassed()
      Indicates only that IR liveness passed for the current sample. It does not independently establish a successful identity match.
